title: BPP success envelope (DESIGN.md §14.2): outcome "ok" plus operation result
description: result is the operation-specific payload; each operation's closed result schema (e.g. hello-result) validates it. revision is the new revision of the mutated object where the operation yields one; source_cursor is an opaque, scope- and audience-bound continuation token (§14.4). Responses are limited to 1 MiB (§14.9), enforced in code.

source_cursor.description: Opaque authenticated continuation token; never interpreted by clients.
